changeSet.author: cashbee
changeSet.comment: Add is_fallback_match column to affiliate_order table. This flag indicates if the order was matched using fallback (context-based) matching instead of the normal tracking code (Sub_id1) matching.

changeSet.author: cashbee
changeSet.comment: Add composite index for fallback matching query on affiliate_click. This index optimizes the query used to find possible click matches by context. Query pattern: WHERE platform_id = ? AND item_id = ? AND shop_id = ? AND created_at BETWEEN ? AND ? AND order_matched = false
